orders: Five cyclic rotations of [auto,s0,d10,s1,d01], then their reversals; repeat twice for 20 rounds. Each arm occupies each position four times.
primary: Per-round geometric mean(d01,d10) / geometric mean(s0,s1), six workloads, exact two-sided sign tests with Holm correction across six metrics. Role-balanced topology contrast; not pure SMT mechanism.
secondary: Per-round geometric mean(d01,d10) / auto and geometric mean(s0,s1) / auto; each six-workload family Holm corrected. These are predeclared descriptive followups, not independent promotion evidence.
estimator: Unchanged tput.py fastest of three DA1-boundary passes, 154x39, six unchanged payloads. Outer round is the unit; do not treat passes/roles as independent replicates.
guards: Fail closed on binary/source hashes, topology, identity, masks, incomplete session, geometry, payload bytes, raw rates. No sampler/preload/per-pass hooks. Snapshots only before/after entire payload.
decision: No runtime promotion from artificial pins. Any improvement vs auto requires separate uninstrumented exact-build replication and full all-metric competitor/startup/latency/correctness gates. A nonsignificant loss is not noninferiority.
limitations: Fixed cores, shared host, producer freely scheduled (can share selected cores), background load, frequency, migrations within baseline mask, no CPU isolation; snapshots do not prove residency or continuous mask constancy. Deterministic balanced orders, not randomization. Baseline wrapped identically; boundary snapshots may affect warm state.
prior_work: Earlier whole-die/producer-domain/helper same-logical-CPU treatments did not manipulate reader/parser same-core vs distinct-core placement within the same L3.
